description: This file contains the implementation of the Country controller class within the OpenCart admin localisation namespace. It manages CRUD operations, listing, filtering, sorting, and pagination for countries in the admin panel.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class for managing country data in the OpenCart admin localisation namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the country listing and handling filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of countries and outputs the country list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Supports fetching filtered, sorted, and paginated country data and generates the country list view.
